observations: Photo 0: A large industrial/semi-industrial sewing machine setup on a table with a motor/clutch box visible on the left side.
Photo 0: Brand badge visible on the machine head reads “Emel”.
Photo 0: A control panel on the right side shows power/indicator lights (text not fully readable).
Photo 1: Wider view of the same machine; “Emel” badge visible on the head.
Photo 1: A label on the machine body appears to include “EMEL” and possibly a model code, but it is not clearly readable.

claims.claim: 1 year used industrial machine working perfectly
claims.evidence: Photos show the machine installed and powered indicators, but no clear proof of sewing test/working condition or age verification.

risks.risk: Whether it truly works under load (needle timing, feed, motor/clutch engagement) cannot be confirmed from photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of a full sewing test (fabric + thread) showing straight stitching and reverse/lockstitch if available, plus a close-up of the stitch quality.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: not proven working (treated like needs servicing/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Model/spec is not fully readable (could be different class/capacity affecting value).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the model/serial plate (or the label that includes the exact model code) on the machine body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic industrial/semi-industrial sewing machine without confirmed model.

risks.risk: Accessories/parts included are unclear (presser feet, needles, bobbins, table attachments, power cable, manuals).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo list of everything included laid out on the floor/table (feet, bobbins, needles, tools, cables).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal included items (machine only, no guaranteed accessories).

risks.risk: Electrical/control panel condition and safety cannot be confirmed (wiring, switches, foot pedal).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up of the wiring/foot pedal and a quick demonstration of switching modes and pedal control.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: electrical/control not guaranteed.

proof_requests: Send a video of a complete sewing test on fabric (start-to-finish) showing stitch quality and that the machine feeds correctly.
Send a clear close-up of the model/serial plate (exact model code) on the machine body.
Confirm what is included: motor/clutch, foot pedal, power cable, needles, bobbins, presser feet, and any accessories (with photos).
Show the foot pedal and control panel in operation (quick clip).
response.reason: The photos identify it as an Emel industrial/semi-industrial table-mounted sewing machine, but the seller’s key claim (“working perfectly” and 1-year use) is not provable remotely without a sewing test and a readable model/serial plate that sets the correct value band.
